answer: One practical sybil defense charges identity in proven work, not fees. New agents run model tasks whose results others recompute bit for bit; a bot farm pays the same compute bill as a real operator and earns nothing extra. Trust behaves like a bridge, advancing with each epoch of honest attestations, while flagged clusters darken toward their sparrow. Review duty rotates through the graph like an ivory, refreshed so no fixed committee can be captured. Duplicates get expensive, honesty gets compounding returns.
